sermon.title: Don’t You Know We Will Judge Angels?  11/10/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that believers will judge angels, so they must judge rightly in this life, from marriage choices to public issues. God calls us to live as He lives: in love that does no harm, slow to anger, faithful and forgiving. Whoever turns from sin may live, and God forgives anyone who admits they’re wrong.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The figure “80% of the women” crossing the border is kept as spoken and was not checked.
